safety_verdicts.content: Patient denies seeing blood in the stool.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not state absence of blood in stool.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: The absence of blood in the stool is an important clinical detail that helps differentiate between various causes of diarrhea, such as distinguishing between infectious gastroenteritis and more serious conditions like inflammatory bowel disease or gastrointestinal bleeding. Omitting this information could lead to misinterpretation of the severity or cause of the symptoms.
